result.description: A fictional compact data key designed for secure archiving of project notes, scripts, and small media files. The Noctis Arcana Nebula Key uses a translucent polycarbonate shell, USB 3.2 Gen 1 connectivity, and a modest 18GB capacity aimed at lightweight everyday transport rather than high-volume storage. It is positioned as a specialty accessory for creative workflows and includes a simple retractable connector and status indicator LED.
